name: nexphone-monorepo
description: NexPhone Platform - Monorepo for API, Admin Dashboard, and Web Portal with multi-flavor support

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,green" -n "api,admin,web" "npm run dev --prefix nexphone-api" "npm run dev --prefix nexphone-admin" "npm run dev --prefix nexphone-web"
scripts.dev:staging: npx -y concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,green" -n "api,admin,web" "npm run dev:staging --prefix nexphone-api" "npm run dev:staging --prefix nexphone-admin" "npm run dev:staging --prefix nexphone-web"
scripts.dev:prod: npx -y concurrently -c "cyan,magenta,green" -n "api,admin,web" "npm run dev:prod --prefix nexphone-api" "npm run dev:prod --prefix nexphone-admin" "npm run dev:prod --prefix nexphone-web"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix nexphone-api && npm run build --prefix nexphone-admin && npm run build --prefix nexphone-web
scripts.build:dev: npm run build --prefix nexphone-api && npm run build:dev --prefix nexphone-admin && npm run build:dev --prefix nexphone-web
scripts.build:staging: npm run build --prefix nexphone-api && npm run build:staging --prefix nexphone-admin && npm run build:staging --prefix nexphone-web
scripts.build:prod: npm run build --prefix nexphone-api && npm run build:prod --prefix nexphone-admin && npm run build:prod --prefix nexphone-web
